title: elymus trachycaulus subsp. stefanssonii
intro: Elymus trachycaulus subsp. stefanssonii, commonly known as Blue Wild Rye or Stefansson's Wild Rye, is a plant species native to the Arctic tundra. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of Elymus trachycaulus subsp. stefanssonii include its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent, inhibiting the growth of certain pathogens, and its possible role as a diuretic, increasing urine production and helping to remove excess fluids from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
